title: ID0440917-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S9 170003971] RFID Reader defect
description: Reported behavior/issue: CPO says that It is not possible to start charging using RFID. It can be charged, but only using a mobile phone. (Backend) Authentication with a charge card does not work. Mabey RFIDReader defect.
